**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent) — redline validated and submitted.**

- **Investigation:** The outline has no insurance heading. A full-text search for "insurance" returned only p0012, where the word appears as a deduction in the Net Revenue definition. I read both planner candidates — Miscellaneous (§14.1–14.10) and Indemnification (§8) — and neither imposes any coverage obligation.
- **Direction check:** Corio (our client) is the licensee/hosting party; Commerce One is the licensor of the Software and provider of the MarketSite Service that supports Corio and its Customers. So the counterparty is the vendor in scope for this rule, and the obligation properly runs against it.
- **Classification:** No coverage at all for a vendor whose service touches Customer data fails even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M), so this is a "missing" finding rather than a fallback-compliant clause.
- **Redline:** Inserted a new §14.10 Insurance after the Bankruptcy clause (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where Customer data is processed, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request), plus a one-word renumber of the existing §14.10 Complete Understanding to §14.11 to avoid a numbering collision. Drafted to match the approved `seed-insurance` precedent, with the fallback limits offered in the comment.
